assumptions: Mismatches are allowed up to the limit given; bulges only when asked.
MIT and CFD are the published scoring schemes.
limits: Specificity is against the sequence searched: it is not a genome-wide score, and it states that.
A site found is a possible cut, not a measured one.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which sites in this sequence could a guide also cut, and how specific is the guide within it?

description: Search a sequence for sites a guide could also cut, allowing mismatches, and score each one (MIT and CFD) plus the aggregate specificity of the guide WITHIN that sequence. This is specificity against what you searched — it is not a genome-wide score, and it says so rather than inventing one.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

circular.description: search across the origin as well. Advanced.

dna_bulge.description: extra bases in the DNA a site may carry (a gap opened in the guide). 0 searches mismatches only. The ceiling is the width a golden oracle covers, and a bulged hit outside that envelope reports `validated: false` for itself. In nt. Advanced.

limit.description: cap the rows returned (hits come back worst-first: fewest mismatches). 0 = all. Advanced.

max_mismatches.description: how many mismatches a site may carry and still be reported.

nuclease.description: which nuclease's PAM and geometry to use. Values: SpCas9 (SpCas9: NGG (3')), SpCas9-NG (SpCas9-NG: NG (3')), SpG (SpG: NGN (3')), SpRY (SpRY: NRN (3')), xCas9 (xCas9: NG (3')), SaCas9 (SaCas9: NNGRRT (3')), SaCas9-KKH (SaCas9-KKH: NNNRRT (3')), AsCas12a (AsCas12a: TTTV (5')), LbCas12a (LbCas12a: TTTV (5')), enAsCas12a (enAsCas12a: TTTV (5')).

rna_bulge.description: extra bases in the guide a site may carry (a gap opened in the DNA). Same envelope as `dna_bulge`. In nt. Advanced.

spacer.description: the protospacer to search for (20 nt for SpCas9).

subject.description: the sequence to search — wire a record or name a library document; leave unset to search the open record.

name: search_off_targets

byMismatch.description: how many sites carry 0, 1, 2 … mismatches — the census a specificity read needs

cfdSpecificity.description: aggregate CFD specificity within the searched sequence, 0-100: the same Hsu-form aggregate over each site's CFD score (null when the nuclease geometry is unscored)

hits.description: each candidate site: position, strand, mismatches, the PAM found, and its MIT/CFD scores

mitSpecificity.description: aggregate MIT specificity within the searched sequence, 0-100 (null when the nuclease geometry is unscored)

scored.description: false when this nuclease has no published MIT/CFD model — the hits are still real, the scores are absent
